query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM translatable
                WHERE
                ($1::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created_at < $1)
                AND ($2::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created_at > $2)
                AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR source_language = $3)
                AND (
                    ($4::bool AND published_at IS NOT NULL)
                    OR ($5::bool AND published_at IS NULL)
                )
